## Observation

`packages/types/src/__tests__/handler-keys-string-any-mirrors-7344.test.ts` builds its `AppComponentSchema.actions[]` reader census by shelling out to `git grep -E` with `\b` word-boundary anchors (`ANCHOR_ACTIONS_READ = '\\.actions\\b'`, `ANCHOR_APP_SHAPED_READ`, and the `\\bAppAction\\b` / `\\bAppComponentSchema\\b` import anchors).
